gloss: somewhat overweight; tending to be heavy; a bit chubby

definitions.gloss: somewhat overweight; tending to be heavy; a bit chubby
definitions.explanation: Slightly heavier than ideal or showing a tendency toward weight gain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧、{太|ふと}り{気味|ぎみ}だ。
examples.english: I've been a bit overweight lately.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運動不足|うんどうぶそく}→運動不足：08567_undoubusoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{太|ふと}り{気味|ぎみ}になってきた。
examples.english: I've been getting a bit heavy due to lack of exercise.

examples.japanese: {太|ふと}り{気味|ぎみ}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{感|かん}じたら→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧、⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧⟦{食生活|しょくせいかつ}→食生活：21071_shokuseikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}して→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧みる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: If you feel you're putting on a bit of weight, it's a good idea to start by reviewing your eating habits.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{太|ふと}り→太る：01190_futoru⟧ (the stem of ⟦{太|ふと}る→太る：01190_futoru⟧, to gain weight) and ⟦{気味|ぎみ}→気味：27635_gimi⟧ (a suffix meaning "tendency" or "somewhat"). The ～⟦{気味|ぎみ}→気味：27635_gimi⟧ pattern is productive and attaches to verb stems and nouns to indicate a slight tendency or mild state.

USAGE:
- Functions as a na-adjective: {太|ふと}り{気味|ぎみ}だ / {太|ふと}り{気味|ぎみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun
- The ～⟦{気味|ぎみ}→気味：27635_gimi⟧ pattern softens the statement — it's less direct than ⟦{太|ふと}っている→太る：01190_futoru⟧
- Other common ～⟦{気味|ぎみ}→気味：27635_gimi⟧ words: ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦{気味|ぎみ}→気味：27635_gimi⟧ (coming down with a cold), ⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧⟦{気味|ぎみ}→気味：27635_gimi⟧ (somewhat tired), ⟦{遅|おく}れ→遅れ：01908_okure⟧⟦{気味|ぎみ}→気味：27635_gimi⟧ (slightly behind schedule)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {太|ふと}り{気味|ぎみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧: a slightly overweight body
- ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{太|ふと}り{気味|ぎみ}: a little on the heavy side
- {太|ふと}り{気味|ぎみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to start getting a bit heavy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{太|ふと}っている→太る：01190_futoru⟧: to be fat/overweight — more direct statement of current state
- ⟦ぽっちゃり→ぽっちゃり：22777_pocchari⟧: plump, chubby — softer and more affectionate tone
- ⟦{肥満|ひまん}→肥満：13920_himan⟧: obesity — medical/formal term; much stronger
- メタボ: metabolic syndrome — colloquial abbreviation; implies health concern
